answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained, verifiable honest service rather than accumulated once. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned sybil has almost no trusted incoming weight and thus near-zero eigenvector centrality; without reciprocal, transitive support from established peers, it cannot meet consensus thresholds. An ember of activity is no anchor: copied identities merely echo one another, not independent trust.
